name: Artemis I
about: Artemis I (2022-156A), a crewed vehicle (Artemis), launched 2022 Nov 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DSO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2022 Nov 16), held fixed
